scenario.goal_zh: 根据现有食物和个人偏好分配晚餐并商定处理多余食物

context_zh: 合住者莉娜和奥马尔查看冰箱里今晚可以吃的剩菜。
author: author-phase06-c

sentences.speaker: Lena
sentences.text: There are two portions of vegetable stew and one of pasta. I do not want to waste any of it.

sentences.speaker: Omar
sentences.text: I would prefer the pasta. You can have whatever is in the blue container if you like it.

sentences.speaker: Lena
sentences.text: That is the stew, and it is plenty for me. What should we do with the extra portion?

sentences.speaker: Omar
sentences.text: Freeze it tonight for another meal. Basically, we each eat one portion now and save the third.

sentences.speaker: Lena
sentences.text: Good. I will label the spare portion before putting it in the freezer, and then we can heat our dinner.

targets.sense_zh: 浪费，使有用的东西未得到使用
任何所指的东西，无论什么
